claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellDurationOverride.endsWhenItemRemoved
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The hat-granted Disguise Self cast ends when the hat is removed — a duration early-end condition tied to item equipment state. GrantedSpellDurationOverride currently only supports removeConcentration and endsWhenGrantedSpellEnds; neither can express 'ends when the granting item is no longer worn/held'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if the hat is removed.
